Rivulet Capital Cut Interxion Holding N.V (INXN) Stake as Share Value Rose; Pfizer (PFE) Shareholder Solaris Asset Management Increased Stake by $321,300 as Valuation Declined
May 1, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Solaris Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Pfizer Inc (PFE) by 135.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Solaris Asset Management Llc bought 8,925 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 15,535 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $563,000, up from 6,610 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Solaris Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Pfizer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $217.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.05% or $0.39 during the last trading session, reaching $36.61. About 26.85 million shares traded or 11.96% up from the average. Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) has risen 2.43% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
